args.text:
Batch: 8 runs, 8 accepted. Flagged: 0. Cleared: 8 (r01–r08).
- All three kinematic checks (rigid-body invariance, closure, plane sections) passed on every run. No run used the width-free ratio, and none had roll backs.
- r03: REGR peak 51.66 %/h, 1.38 %/h below the batch median. Its z of -46.5 is large only because the MAD is 0.02. Peak position, growth-zone length and flank difference match the batch, so this is a slightly slower root.
- r04: kept one remedy (frames registered on non-growing tissue from 400 px). All checks pass after it, and its profile matches the batch.
- r06: largest flank difference -8.36 %/h, 0.32 %/h from the median. Its z of -3.3 is large because the MAD is small. Its position and REGR profile match the batch.
- Note: r01 matches r05 exactly, and r02, r07 and r08 match each other exactly, in every check value and summary. Their checks and profiles are all sound, but it is worth confirming upstream that these are separate roots and time windows, not the same measurement counted more than once.
- Because no runs were flagged, there is nothing they have in common to report.
